kml_references: D/S labels refer to plotted points in the same interval, not necessarily the exact CSV cycle timestamp. Blank means no point plotted in that interval. SX means rejected/unknown surfer packet.
report_sampling: Last control cycle per interval from window start, per source/session; then skip unchanged selected readings. GPS age counts; timestamps do not. Raw JSONL unsampled.
kml_sampling: Same intervals as CSV; last actual logged position per subject/interval, then omit unchanged coordinates unless --keep-unchanged. No GPS forward fill. Point times remain actual logged times.
waiting_area_definition: GPS estimate at last cycle: at least 5.0s, 6 accepted packets, cluster diameter <= 1.5m, gaps and latest GPS age <= 1.5s. Blank if insufficient/gapped GPS. False if VT riding during interval. Not verified body posture.
selection: Top-level epochMs; fallback timestamp. No deduplication or event filtering.
